medicine: NSAIDs (Flunixin / Meloxicam) + Antibiotics for secondary infections + Antiseptic sprays
treatment: 1. Isolate infected animal immediately. 2. Clean wounds with antiseptic (Potassium Permanganate 1%). 3. Apply Glycerin + Boric acid on mouth lesions. 4. Provide soft food and clean water. 5. Consult vet for supportive antiviral therapy.
precautions: 1. FMD is highly contagious - strict isolation needed. 2. Disinfect all equipment and housing daily. 3. Restrict animal movement in and out of farm. 4. Vaccinate healthy animals immediately. 5. Report to local animal husbandry department.

medicine: Amitraz dips + Ivermectin / Doramectin injection + Lime sulfur dips + Topical acaricides
treatment: 1. Isolate infected animal from herd. 2. Clip hair around affected areas for better medicine penetration. 3. Wash affected skin with medicated shampoo. 4. Apply Amitraz dip on entire body once a week for 4 weeks. 5. Give Ivermectin injection as prescribed by vet.
precautions: 1. Mange mites spread through direct contact - strict isolation needed. 2. Disinfect all bedding and grooming tools thoroughly. 3. Treat all herd animals even if not showing symptoms. 4. Wear gloves when handling infected animals. 5. Do not use infected animal milk during treatment.
